notes.title: Finally, we're back !!!
notes.content:
Hi

It's been a long time ...

Finally, we're back to the full development of SEXY GIRLS.

We apologize for the delay in releasing the game. Sometimes in life it happens that bosses are more focused on profit than product quality.
This led to a difference in opinions inside the development team and a small rebellion :-)
After almost a year, we communicated with the boss and bought the rights to SEXY GIRLS and left the company and here we are.

We are very excited to start working on our own account.
We are fully committed to SEXY GIRLS development.

In a few months we will show a new teaser and new sexy girls who will also be in the game.

We thank you for your patience.
